Export a dbVisuals spec as an htmlwidget

dbvisuals_export_htmlwidget.Rd

Renders a Mosaic or deck.gl specification through rMosaic or rDeckgl and saves the resulting htmlwidget to disk. This is intended for durable exports from dbVisuals specs; the live dbVisuals canvas continues to use the SQLRooms React runtime.

Usage

dbvisuals_export_htmlwidget(
  spec,
  file,
  engine = "auto",
  data = NULL,
  data_sql = NULL,
  data_name = "agent_data",
  con = NULL,
  db_path = NULL,
  project = NULL,
  selfcontained = FALSE,
  data_transport = "file",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

export_htmlwidget(...)

Arguments

spec

A widget specification as an R list, JSON string, JSON file path, or an existing htmlwidget. Mosaic specs are rendered with rMosaic; deck.gl specs are rendered with rDeckgl.

file

Output HTML file path.

engine

Export target. "auto" infers from the spec shape; "rMosaic" and "rDeckgl" select the R package explicitly. "mosaic" and "deckgl" are accepted aliases.

data

Optional named list of data.frames to register for the widget.

data_sql

Optional SQL query to fetch from con, db_path, project, or the active SQLRooms database and register as data_name.

data_name

Name used when registering data_sql results.

con

Optional DBI connection used for data_sql or direct DuckDB data nodes in an rDeckgl spec.

db_path

Optional DuckDB database path used to open a temporary read-only connection for export.

project

Optional dbProject object or DBI connection.

selfcontained

Passed to htmlwidgets::saveWidget(). Defaults to FALSE so large exports can keep dependencies and Arrow payloads as files.

data_transport

Data transport passed to rMosaic::mosaic() or rDeckgl::deckgl(). Defaults to "file" to avoid base64 Arrow payloads in JSON.

width, height

Optional widget dimensions.

...

Arguments passed to dbvisuals_export_htmlwidget().

Value

Invisibly returns a list describing the exported file, engine, dependency directory, and generated data files.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
spec <- list(
  plot = list(list(
    mark = "dot",
    data = list(from = "cells"),
    x = "x",
    y = "y"
  ))
)
dbvisuals_export_htmlwidget(
  spec,
  "scatter.html",
  engine = "rMosaic",
  data = list(cells = data.frame(x = 1:10, y = 1:10))
)
} # }
